purpose: Persistent multi-agent work-state coordination with explicit assignments, lifecycle transitions, blocks, steps and audit history through MCP.

wire_contract.authority: Normative request/response fields, defaults, pagination, bounds and operation-specific errors.

tool_semantics.auftrag_create: Create a validated queued Auftrag with explicit steps, constraints and acceptance fields. assigned_to and predecessor_id must be empty/omitted; assignment and replacement use their dedicated tools.
tool_semantics.auftrag_list: Read bounded Auftrag summaries by public filters.
tool_semantics.auftrag_get: Read one Auftrag including steps, blocks and progress.
tool_semantics.auftrag_assign: Assign a queued Auftrag under creator/role policy.
tool_semantics.auftrag_reassign_replace: Atomically terminate the old executable token as cancelled with reason REPLACED and create one assigned replacement whose immutable predecessor_id is the old ID. Copy specification and remaining steps, never completed effects; old Auftrag cannot resume/start/checkpoint.
tool_semantics.auftrag_start: Transition assigned to active and activate the first step.
tool_semantics.auftrag_checkpoint: Record one step result and advance only under the declared FSM. skipped is legal only for optional=true steps and advances like pass; required-step skip is INVALID_TRANSITION.
tool_semantics.auftrag_block: Record a blocking condition without losing the work token.
tool_semantics.auftrag_resume: Resolve the active block and restore the previous legal state.
tool_semantics.auftrag_close: Close only when acceptance and lifecycle preconditions are met. success/partial map to done; fail maps to failed and requires root_cause.
tool_semantics.auftrag_cancel: Use the explicit terminal escape only from declared cancellable states.
tool_semantics.auftrag_get_changelog: Read append-only lifecycle and actor audit events.
tool_semantics.get_instance_activity: Read bounded activity summaries without private profile topology.

identity_authority.trusted_boundary: Configured CredentialProvider validates raw transport credentials and constructs Principal before MCP dispatch. Tool arguments, assignee names, forwarded metadata and private profile identifiers never construct authority.
identity_authority.principal_validation: All fields required; identifiers canonical UTF-8 1..128; role declared; issuer/audience exact configured match; issued_at no more than 30 seconds future; expiry valid; revocation active. Any absence, conflict, malformed or provider-indeterminate claim denies before dispatch.
identity_authority.canonical_comparison: Unicode NFC then exact case-sensitive byte comparison; missing caller claim where declared returns IDENTITY_MISMATCH.
identity_authority.mismatch_order: Compare before Auftrag lookup, assignment disclosure, transition, changelog query, activity query or adapter path. Mismatch may write only a redacted security event.
identity_authority.rule: caller_instance_id is compatibility assertion only and must equal authenticated subject_id. Delegation is not supported in v1.
identity_authority.anonymous_policy: All 13 MCP tools require authentication. Anonymous HTTP allowlist is exactly health and version; responses contain status and public version only.

credential_lifecycle.provider_boundary: Issuance, PKCE/code single use where OAuth applies, protected storage, hashing/encryption, scopes, rotation, revocation, replay detection, cleanup and compromise response are CredentialProvider responsibilities. OAuth tables never directly construct a Principal.
credential_lifecycle.expiry_policy: Reject missing expiry, expired credentials and invalid/future issued_at before dispatch.
credential_lifecycle.revocation_policy: Reject revoked or indeterminate status; lookup/cache failure is deny; revocation cache maximum TTL 30 seconds.
credential_lifecycle.replay_policy: Authorization codes single-use and PKCE-bound in provider; credential_id audience-bound; request_id deduplicates state mutations.
credential_lifecycle.failure_policy: AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED without token, code, claim dump or fallback caller identity.

operations.assign: creator planner while queued; admin may bypass creator relation but not state or assignee eligibility
operations.reassign_replace: creator planner while queued/assigned; admin bypasses creator relation; predecessor remains immutable
operations.start_checkpoint_close: assigned worker; admin bypasses assignee relation but not FSM/step/KPI preconditions
operations.block_resume: creator planner, assigned worker, or admin relation bypass
operations.cancel: creator planner from queued only; admin relation bypass but queued-only remains
operations.read: planner only creator-owned; worker only assigned; auditor all tenant objects read-only; admin all tenant objects

authorization_model.admin_relation_policy: Admin bypasses creator/assignee relation only. Admin never bypasses FSM, terminal immutability, input, audit, idempotency or eligibility rules; bypass action is audited with reason_code ADMIN_RELATION_BYPASS.
authorization_model.auditor_relation_policy: Auditor may read all objects/changelog/activity in the configured single tenant but cannot mutate; sensitive free text remains redacted and queries are bounded/audited.
authorization_model.assignee_eligibility: PrincipalDirectory must resolve new_assigned_to to an active non-revoked worker/admin principal in the configured tenant. Unknown, disabled, wrong-tenant or ineligible subjects deny before mutation.
authorization_model.self_assignment: Planner cannot assign self unless PrincipalDirectory also grants worker role; admin remains subject to eligibility.
authorization_model.object_scope: Each Auftrag stores creator_id and assigned_to subject IDs; operation matrix defines when relation is required or explicitly bypassed.

privacy.coverage_rule: Every persisted string, string-list member and string-valued decoded JSON leaf is potential_pii unless explicitly classified as validated operational identifier or closed enum; recursively scan before Auftrag, step, block, changelog, index or log persistence.
privacy.write_policy: Validate and redact every listed free-text field before persistence using stable [REDACTED:<CLASS>] markers; never place credentials or private topology in Auftrag content, changelog or logs.
privacy.read_policy: Return redacted Auftrag content. get_instance_activity returns only actor subject_id, action, occurred_at, Auftrag ID and result code; no host, profile path, network route or credential metadata.
privacy.logging_policy: No request body, token, auth code, private adapter payload or rejected raw value in logs/audit.

audit.failure_policy: Mutation and changelog event commit in one SQLite transaction or neither commits. Changelog insertion failure rolls back state/assignment/step change.
audit.append_protection: Canonical triggers changelog_no_update/changelog_no_delete and identity_audit_no_update/identity_audit_no_delete abort mutations. Startup verifies both closed column sets and all four trigger SQL digests; mismatch, extra column or absence sets read-only tamper mode and all writes return INTERNAL_ERROR.

lifecycle.block_resume_rule: Store previous_state on block; resume only to that legal previous_state after an explicit resolution.
lifecycle.checkpoint_rule: Only assigned worker/admin; pass advances one active step; skipped advances only an optional=true step; fail moves Auftrag to failed; final pass/allowed skip moves active to validating. Wrong/out-of-order/replayed step denies atomically.
lifecycle.close_rule: Only assigned worker/admin from validating with all required steps pass, optional steps pass/skipped and valid KPI payload. result success/partial -> done; result fail -> failed and non-empty root_cause required.
lifecycle.invalid_transition: Return INVALID_TRANSITION without mutation or adapter call.

errors.transport: stable JSON envelope with status, code, correlation_id and non-sensitive message
errors.existence_oracle_policy: Unauthorized and absent Auftraege return the same NOT_FOUND envelope after authentication; no prior state, assignee or acceptance content leaks.
errors.invalid_input_policy: Return field name and validation code only; never echo rejected value, OAuth material or raw body.
errors.dependency_error_policy: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE names only public dependency class and correlation_id, never endpoint, route, host, token or private payload.
errors.side_effect_policy: Public core performs no Telegram, Witness, webhook, trigger-file or federation side effect. Adapter absence is normal and cannot alter core transaction result.

idempotency_concurrency.mutation_key: request_id is required non-empty ASCII [A-Za-z0-9._:-], length 1..128; no Unicode/whitespace normalization; exact bytes plus subject and tool form identity
idempotency_concurrency.duplicate_same_payload: same canonical RFC8785-style JSON payload returns original result without second state advance or business audit event
idempotency_concurrency.assignment_control: state/version and assignee relation checked inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
idempotency_concurrency.checkpoint_control: step active-state and request_id checked atomically; out-of-order, replayed or wrong-step checkpoints deny
idempotency_concurrency.retry: same request_id only for documented transient provider/database error

stable: declared lifecycle states and transition meanings
compatibility.claimed_actor_migration: Existing caller_instance_id parameters remain during a deprecation window as assertion-only mismatch-deny fields.
compatibility.breaking_change: Requires versioned contract, migration/alias strategy, consumer impact, compatibility tests and explicit owner decision.
compatibility.identity_upgrade: Breaking pre-1.0 draft change: every public tool requires signed shared Identity Envelope; legacy caller claims remain non-authoritative assertions only.

stability.versioning: SemVer begins only after first accepted public contract
stability.deprecation: minimum one documented release or explicit pre-1.0 break decision
stability.immutability: released versions and artifacts are never silently replaced

statement_limits: This contract is not implementation evidence.
Optional adapters are not part of core lifecycle acceptance.
Local SQLite evidence does not prove a deployed multi-instance runtime.

identity_envelope_contract.principal: principal_pubkey is sole request author and must equal verified request signer

owner_attestation.semantics: authorization evidence only; never rewrites author

profile_binding.spawn_rule: single fail-closed chokepoint; key+attestation+tenant+profile hash+runtime generation must resolve together

request_binding.tenant_rule: tenant_id must equal server-resolved tenant; never selects tenant
request_binding.signature_rule: Ed25519 over the domain-separated RFC8785 canonical envelope without signature; payload_sha256 binds the exact finite-JSON raw request after removing identity_envelope
request_binding.freshness: issued_at/expires_at required; bounded server clock skew

replay.order: verify signatures and bindings before atomic shared set-if-absent

revocation.effect: deny new request immediately; terminate or revalidate active session; invalidate caches; audit safely

compatibility_claims: caller_instance_id is assertion-only and cannot authorize
legacy bearer/provider credentials cannot bypass signed envelope
no caller-controlled or process-global credential fallback; endpoint-scoped one-use in-memory capabilities are exact-request-bound and cannot bypass the signed envelope
